protocol: scripts/check_compiled_forces.py MODEL --mode inference. Same weights and seed, evaluation mode, two molecules of 5 and 4 atoms. Evaluate E and Fa through regular torch.compile with an instrumented Inductor backend, then compute the derivative of the returned energy with respect to positions twice. Errors are measured against the same eager call. A pass means the listed learned operators were captured; native gradients means no learned operator was captured.
reusable_buffers: The original caller used PyTorch defaults for the two retained external backwards. Controls disable donated_buffer only during those two derivative calls, after the ordinary forward returns.
